name: Space-Time Image Formation Model
definition: A model representing a continuously deforming 3D object as a 4D density function h(x, y, z, t), discretized into Nk frames, each represented by a voxel grid of Nv voxels, assuming each frame is approximately static for reconstruction.
summary: The Space-Time Image Formation Model represents dynamic scenes as a 4D density function discretized into static frames, using a unified representation that tolerates topology changes but may cause time inconsistency.
